problem.passage:
Marine biologists have long debated why some deep-sea octopus species brood their eggs for exceptionally long periods—one species was observed guarding a single clutch for over four years, far longer than most cephalopods. A team studying a population living near cold seeps proposed that the extreme depth and near-freezing temperatures at these sites, rather than any behavioral adaptation, explain the unusually long brooding period. To test this idea, the researchers compared metabolic rates of octopuses at different depths and found that individuals in colder, deeper water had metabolic rates roughly 50 percent lower than those in shallower, warmer water nearby. Lower metabolic rates are associated with slower embryonic development in many marine species. The team also noted that octopuses at the cold seep site rarely left their eggs to forage, even though prey was available nearby, suggesting that the animals were physiologically capable of normal activity but chose not to leave their clutch unguarded.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' claim that low temperature, rather than behavior, explains the long brooding period?

To test this idea, the researchers compared metabolic rates of octopuses at different depths and found that individuals in colder, deeper water had metabolic rates roughly 50 percent lower than those in shallower, warmer water nearby. Lower metabolic rates are associated with slower embryonic development in many marine species. The team also noted that octopuses at the cold seep site rarely left their eggs to forage, even though prey was available nearby, suggesting that the animals were physiologically capable of normal activity but chose not to leave their clutch unguarded.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researchers' claim that low temperature, rather than behavior, explains the long brooding period?
options: Octopuses moved to warmer tanks in captivity completed embryonic development in a fraction of the time observed at the cold seep site.
Octopuses at the cold seep site were never observed leaving their eggs, even when food was scarce nearby.
Researchers at a separate warm-water site recorded a brooding period nearly as long as the one at the cold seep site.
The eggs collected from the cold seep site were slightly larger on average than eggs from the shallower population.
problem.explanation: 정답 A는 온도를 실험적으로 조작해 발달 기간이 극적으로 줄어드는 것을 보여주므로, 저온이 대사율을 낮춰 발생 속도를 늦춘다는 인과 주장을 가장 직접적으로 뒷받침한다. B는 어미가 알을 떠나지 않는다는 행동 관찰로, 오히려 행동적 요인을 강조할 수도 있어 저자의 '행동이 아니라 온도' 주장과는 다른 방향을 가리킨다. C는 따뜻한 곳에서도 비슷하게 긴 포란기가 나타났다는 것으로, 온도가 원인이라는 주장을 반박하는 증거이다. D는 알 크기 차이로 발생 기간과는 무관한 세부사항이라 주장을 뒷받침하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Choice A shows that experimentally manipulating temperature alone dramatically shortens development time, directly supporting the causal claim that cold temperature—via lowered metabolic rate—extends brooding duration. Choice B describes maternal guarding behavior, which could actually support a behavioral explanation rather than a temperature-based one. Choice C reports a similarly long brooding period in warm water, which would undermine rather than support the temperature claim. Choice D concerns egg size, an unrelated detail that does not bear on developmental duration.
problem.evidenceTarget: Low water temperature, not a behavioral choice, is the primary cause of the unusually long brooding period observed at the cold seep site.
problem.evidenceSpan: individuals in colder, deeper water had metabolic rates roughly 50 percent lower than those in shallower, warmer water nearby
problem.answerRationale: 체온 조작 실험에서 온도만 바꿨을 때 발달 기간이 크게 단축된다면, 이는 저온이 대사율 저하를 통해 발생 기간을 늘린다는 인과관계를 직접 입증하며 지문의 대사율 데이터를 실험적으로 확증한다.

difficultyReasons: 온도-대사율-발생속도라는 인과 사슬을 정확히 파악해야 함
오답 B는 행동적 설명을 뒷받침하는 정반대 방향의 근거라는 점을 구분해야 해서 혼동을 유발함
오답 C는 비교 구조를 반박 증거로 오인하게 만들어 한 단계 추가 추론이 필요함
오답 D는 지문에 언급되지 않은 새로운 변수(알 크기)를 끌어들여 관련성 여부를 판단해야 함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 지문에 '드물게 먹이를 찾으러 떠난다'는 내용이 있어 이와 유사하게 보임
distractors.matches: octopuses at the cold seep site rarely left their eggs to forage 부분과 표면적으로 일치
distractors.whyWrong: 이 발견은 온도가 아니라 행동적 요인(보호 행동)을 뒷받침하는 근거이며, 연구자들의 주장(온도가 원인)과는 반대로 행동적 설명을 강화한다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 온도 차이에 따른 비교라는 점에서 그럴듯해 보임
distractors.matches: cold seep site와 대비되는 warm-water site라는 설정이 지문의 비교 구조와 유사
distractors.whyWrong: 따뜻한 곳에서도 비슷하게 긴 포란 기간이 나타난다면, 이는 온도가 원인이 아니라는 것을 시사하여 연구자들의 주장을 반박하는 근거가 된다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 알의 크기 차이가 발생 속도와 관련 있을 수 있다는 상식적 추측을 유도
distractors.matches: cold seep site의 알과 얕은 물의 알을 비교한다는 점에서 지문의 비교 구조와 유사
distractors.whyWrong: 알 크기는 지문에서 언급된 대사율이나 발생 속도와 직접적인 인과관계가 없으며, 온도-대사율-발생속도 가설을 직접 검증하지 않음
